name: spinloop
description: Run micromagnetic simulations on your Mac and get answers, not output directories. Writes verified .mx3 scripts, runs them and shows the result, searches a parameter until a target is met, checks whether the mesh is fine enough to trust, matches against measured hysteresis data, reproduces a paper's setup, fits several parameters to many simulated measurements at once, and answers theory questions from a built-in reference library. Built on mumax3-ultrafast, the Apple Silicon Metal port.
